# SGH Voice

> A multilingual input tool by Shingihou Co., Ltd. The Android keyboard combines voice, Zhuyin, Japanese, and English input in one IME. A separate macOS app supports mixed Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and English dictation.

## Current Android test release

- Version: 2.8.2 (version code 32)
- Platform: Android 8.0 or later
- Distribution status: personal test build, distributed as a versioned APK from the official SGH Voice website
- Google Play status: not currently published through Google Play Production
- Download: https://voice.shingihou.com/downloads/SGHVoice-Android-v2.8.2.apk
- File size: 17,402,665 bytes (16.60 MiB)
- SHA-256: f7952c4685f07fb89f5b3107735c9812f7dd09793c367f46e9bed2a61fcd998e
- App price: free
- Cloud usage: BYOK; OpenAI, Anthropic, or Groq usage charges may apply

### Android capabilities

- Four modes in one Android input method: Voice, Zhuyin, Japanese, and English
- SGH Voice brand and icon remain visible at the top left of the keyboard
- Tap for normal dictation; long-press to select 1–4 translation targets from Traditional Chinese, Japanese, English, and Korean
- One large light-colored circle handles recording start, recording state, and stop; choose from six light palettes in basic settings (mint by default). Ripples inside respond gently to actual audio and remain calm during silence
- Voice mode replaces the bottom-row @ key with the ideographic comma 、 and keeps the ， (comma) and 。 (full stop) keys
- Compact mode selector and a larger Enter symbol
- Short and long dictation both use one cleanup request to the selected AI, considering the recorded passage for punctuation, clear stutters, and sentence flow while preserving meaning
- Multi-target translation uses one speech-recognition pass and one strict JSON LLM request
- Dictated questions and instructions remain transcript content; detected assistant chatter, unrelated rewrites, or changes to protected numbers and negation trigger a source-transcript fallback with a visible notice
- Built-in technical vocabulary includes GitHub Actions, CI/CD, and git push; custom terms and human-confirmed correction vocabulary guide later STT and AI cleanup
- Standard Zhuyin layout without requiring Pinyin
- Pinned Traditional Chinese Zhuyin lexicon with 133,492 readings, 157,683 candidates, and 145,332 phrase candidates
- Associated-phrase completion, including 刪 followed by 除, plus up to 200 on-device custom Zhuyin terms
- Japanese romaji, kana, katakana, and reading-prefix candidate prediction
- Up to 48 Zhuyin candidates with a horizontal strip and an expandable three-column, multi-row view
- Japanese 12-key phone layout with aligned kana columns, tap cycling and long-press selection; switchable with romaji, not flick input
- Explicit Help me write mode accumulates spoken notes, generates a draft through the selected AI and requires preview/explicit insertion
- On editor changes, recording stops and captured speech is retained as pending text, never inserted automatically into a new field
- Failed transcription offers explicit retry or discard; a single bounded audio buffer (up to about 125 seconds) stays only in memory
- Selectable STT and LLM models with the actual provider model ID and a dated public-pricing reference shown in Android settings
- Groq GPT OSS post-processing uses low reasoning effort to limit latency and reasoning-token consumption
- English QWERTY input
- On-device candidate-frequency learning and short correction rules
- Eligible delete-then-retype edits can form one short manual correction; deletion alone is not recorded as a learned replacement
- English vocabulary hints use complete terms instead of isolated changed characters; this is bounded personalization, not STT or LLM model retraining
- Personalization disabled in password and no-personalization fields
- Undo and clear controls for local learning

### Android limitations and installation notice

- This APK is a sideloaded personal test build, not a public Google Play release
- Official sideload installations of 2.7.3–2.8.0 can update directly to 2.8.2 with the same package name and signing certificate; users should not uninstall first
- Previously mistaken learning records are not automatically erased by the update; users can undo the latest learning or clear local learning data from the personal dictionary screen
- Google Play test installations should update through their original install channel
- Review and accept cloud-processing consent version 3 in Settings if not yet accepted; consent already accepted in 2.7.6 remains valid, and existing keys and vocabulary are retained
- Includes the Android 8 and 9 Unicode script syntax compatibility fix from 2.7.7
- 2.8.2 adds writing previews, six selectable light recording colors that fade softly from the center with no outline, larger Zhuyin keys, Japanese phone-grid input, and bounded layouts for small windows
- Notes, pending drafts and retry audio disappear when the input-method service ends or the device restarts; continuous background recording is not supported
- Cloud consent is checked before each new request; withdrawal prevents follow-up AI requests and retry uploads
- Automated checks and emulator inspection do not establish real-device dictation accuracy; the physical-device acceptance checklist remains pending
- Android requires the user to allow installation from the browser or file manager used for the download
- Compatibility and stability can vary by device; users should evaluate sideloading risks before installation
- Keep Google Play Protect enabled
- Japanese conversion is Phase 1 and does not yet provide sentence-level contextual conversion comparable to a mature Japanese IME such as Mozc
- Google Play's 12-tester, 14-day closed-test requirement applies to personal developer accounts created after November 13, 2023 when applying for Production access; it is not a requirement for every developer account or for directly installing this APK

## Current macOS public release

- Version: 2.6.0
- Platform: macOS on Apple Silicon
- Download: https://github.com/linchichuan/sgh-voice/releases/tag/v2.6.0
- App price: free
- Cloud usage: BYOK; provider charges may apply

### macOS capabilities

- Mixed Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and English dictation
- Protection for Latin text, kana, URLs, code, numbers, and abbreviations during post-processing
- Direct insertion at the active cursor
- Restoration of the original clipboard after insertion
- Custom dictionary and verified personalization
- Configurable shortcuts and AI providers
- Optional on-device speech recognition on supported Apple Silicon Macs

## Data handling

- Android API keys use encrypted on-device storage
- Android learning data is stored locally on the device
- Human-confirmed correction targets and custom terms may be sent as vocabulary hints to the selected STT and AI; full correction records and candidate frequency stay on device
- AI output does not automatically become confirmed vocabulary, and Android does not create a complete dictation-history file
- Android recording begins only after the user taps the recording control
- When cloud speech recognition is selected, audio is sent directly to the provider configured by the user
- Shingihou does not store Android audio on an intermediate relay server
- Third-party data handling and fees follow the selected provider's terms and privacy policy
